core_mechanic: Story unfolds across discrete chapters released over time; the choice is the verb.
player_motivation: See how the story responds to me, then come back for the next beat.

essential_feel.choice_weight: decisions are remembered and visibly echo across chapters
essential_feel.cliffhanger_cadence: every chapter ends on a hook

pacing_profile.early: Set the cast and the central tension in chapter 1.
pacing_profile.mid: Chapters 2-N branch on prior choices; stakes escalate.
pacing_profile.late: Convergent finale; multiple endings tied to choice ledger.

progression_model.completion_definition: All chapters played; true endings unlocked through specific choice combinations.
progression_model.content_cadence: Per chapter drop (weeks to months apart); recap and 'previously on' bridge gaps.

canonical_examples.title: Life is Strange
canonical_examples.what_makes_it_special: Time-rewind verb makes choice itself the core mechanic.

anti_patterns: Choices that feel illusory by chapter 3
Long gaps between chapters with no narrative recap
Cliffhangers paid off without acknowledging player's last choice
